title: Optional additional coverages.
bodyText: The commissioner shall, in the same manner as in section 431:10C-410, set rates for any optional additional coverages the plan shall offer.
bodyHtml: §431:10C-411  Optional additional coverages.  The commissioner shall, in the same manner as in section 431:10C-410, set rates for any optional additional coverages the plan shall offer. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
